spec.description: Debug view for the selected tests: duration over time, comparison with the baseline, comparison per server version, and the health of the whole run. Open this board from a test name on the Regressions, Repo Health or Trends boards, or select tests with the Test name selector.
spec.title: Test Details (v16)

spec.description: The duration of each selected test over time, one line per server version. Each point is the slowest run of that day, so spikes stay visible. Add tests with the Test name selector, or click rows in the details table below.
spec.title: Duration timeline for selected tests

spec.expr:
max_over_time(cae_v16_test_duration_seconds{test_id=~"$test_id", vcs_repository_name=~"$repository", server_version=~"$server_version", vcs_repository_ref_name=~"$branch"}[1d])
/
quantile_over_time(0.5, cae_v16_test_duration_seconds{test_id=~"$test_id", vcs_repository_name=~"$repository", server_version=~"$server_version", vcs_repository_ref_name=~"$branch"}[$baseline])

spec.description: The duration of each selected test, divided by its own typical (baseline) duration, over time. 1 = the usual speed. The dashed red line is the slowdown threshold. A short spike is one bad run. A line that stays above the threshold is a regression. A slow climb is a gradual slowdown.
spec.title: Times slower than usual

spec.description: The number of runs of each selected test, per day. A gap means the test or its CI job did not run. Be careful with the timeline above around those days.
spec.title: Runs counted per day

spec.description: The typical (recent) duration of each selected test, one bar per combination of test name and server version. Bars of equal length mean the test behaves the same on every version. One long bar means the test is slow on that version only.
spec.title: Typical duration per server version (recent)

spec.description: The time since each selected test last reported a result. A healthy value is below the repository's CI interval. A larger value means the test was removed, renamed, or its job is broken. The timeline above then shows old data.
spec.title: Hours since this test last ran

spec.description: The exact numbers for the selected tests, per server version: typical (recent), typical (baseline), change, runs counted, and verdict. Click a row to add that test to the selection.
spec.title: Selected tests - details

spec.description: The number of failed and errored tests in the whole run of the selected repository - not only the selected tests. If the run had failures when a selected test spiked, the cause can be the run, not the test.
spec.title: Whole-run health: failed & errored tests

spec.description: The total test time of the whole run for the selected repository. If this moved together with a selected test, the run became slower as a whole - examine the runner or the infrastructure.
spec.title: Whole-run total test time
